outcome: Trends of low umbilical arterial (UA) pH
cohort: 10,696,831 in-hospital live births in Germany from 2008 to 2022
finding: Rates of low 5-min Apgar scores and UA pH in liveborn infants increased from 2008 to 2022 in Germany.
mod_finding: The risk amplification of low Apgar scores was highest after instrumental delivery, while spontaneously born infants had the highest increase in pH < 7.10.
